prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Atlanta for a car accident case?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single, objective “best” personal injury lawyer for every car-accident case — the right lawyer depends on the facts of your accident and what you need (trial experience, speed, communication style, medical-lien handling, etc.). I can help you find a top attorney for your case; first, here’s how to pick one and some next steps.

How to choose the best lawyer for your car accident
- Look for specific car-accident/personal-injury experience (not just general practice).  
- Trial experience and a record of substantial settlements/verdicts if your case may need litigation.  
- Positive client reviews and peer ratings (Avvo, Martindale-Hubbell, Super Lawyers, Google).  
- Clear contingency-fee terms (typical range 33%–40% if settled before suit) and written fee agreement.  
- Good communication — you should get straightforward answers and timely responses.  
- Knowledge of medical liens, subrogation issues, and local court procedures.  
- Free consultation and willingness to explain strategy and likely outcomes.

Places to search and verify attorneys
- Atlanta Bar Association Lawyer Referral Service.  
- State Bar of Georgia lawyer directory.  
- Directories/ratings: Avvo, Martindale-Hubbell, Super Lawyers, Google reviews, Better Business Bureau.

What to ask at a free consultation
- How many car-accident cases have you handled and how many went to trial?  
- Typical outcomes and examples of settlements/verdicts for similar cases.  
- Who will handle my case day-to-day (attorney vs. paralegal)?  
- How do you charge (contingency %, costs, when costs are paid)?  
- Expected timeline and what you should do now (medical care, records, evidence preservation).

If you want, I can:
- Provide a short list (3–5) of highly rated Atlanta personal-injury attorneys/firms for car accidents (based on local reputation and ratings) — tell me your ZIP code or neighborhood and any special needs (serious injury, wrongful death, uninsured motorist, need for Spanish-speaking attorney, etc.).  
- Draft a short list of questions to use in consultations.

Which would you like me to do? If you give your location and a few details about the accident, I’ll prepare tailored recommendations.
